meta.title: Terms of Service · Ziwei Natal Chart
meta.description: Terms of service and user agreement for Ziwei Natal Chart

overview.heading: 1. Service Overview
overview.body: Ziwei Natal Chart (the “Platform”) provides natal chart calculation and reading services based on the Ziwei Doushu (Purple Star Astrology) system in Ni Haixia’s Tian Ji. All astrological content on the Platform is for reference only and does not constitute any medical, investment, legal or psychological counseling advice, or advice on major life decisions.

conduct.heading: 2. User Conduct
conduct.intro: By using the Platform, you agree:
conduct.lawfulUse: to use the Platform only for lawful, personal reference purposes
conduct.noRedistribution: not to distribute the Platform’s content for commercial sale, reposting or public release
conduct.noDisruption: not to engage in any conduct that disrupts the Platform’s normal operation
conduct.truthfulBirthInfo: that the birth information you submit is true and valid; the Platform is not responsible for inaccurate readings caused by incorrect information

ip.heading: 3. Intellectual Property and Prohibitions · No Scraping, No Training
ip.ownership: All of the Platform’s astrological content, knowledge base (including every reading text for 14 main stars × 12 palaces × male and female × Four Transformations × decades and years), UI design, algorithm integration approach and case library are original to the Platform or have been lawfully compiled.
ip.prohibited: The following conduct is strictly prohibited, and the Platform reserves the right to pursue violators for civil damages and criminal liability:
ip.scraping: (1) scraping the Platform’s content by crawlers, automated scripts, bulk API calls or any other technical means;
ip.training: (2) using natal chart readings, text or API response data generated by the Platform **to train any machine learning model** (including but not limited to large language models, astrology generation models and text generation models);
ip.resale: (3) reselling content generated by the Platform, or publishing it on other websites, apps or social media accounts;
ip.cloning: (4) decompiling, copying or modifying the Platform’s front-end or back-end code and offering a similar service as your “own”.
ip.penalty: Text output by the Platform carries embedded fingerprint watermarks for tracing, and output produced by prohibited copying / training can be detected and traced. Once a violation is found, the Platform is entitled to claim RMB 1 million in damages for breach per instance, and reserves the right to file a lawsuit in court and to cooperate with police investigations.

disclaimer.heading: 4. Disclaimer
disclaimer.accuracy: The Platform’s astrological content is compiled from knowledge of traditional Ziwei Doushu and Ni Haixia’s system, and is not guaranteed to be 100% accurate. Destiny is influenced jointly by the Three Powers of heaven, earth and humanity, and the Platform’s output serves only as a reference for understanding yourself. Users should view it rationally and should not rely too heavily on any single astrological judgment.
disclaimer.liability: The Platform bears no legal liability for any consequences arising from the use of its content (including but not limited to mistaken decisions, psychological effects and changes in relationships).

changes.heading: 5. Service Changes and Termination
changes.body: The Platform reserves the right to adjust, suspend or terminate some or all of its services at any time. Users will be notified of major changes by on-site announcement or email.

law.heading: 6. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
law.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the People’s Republic of China. If a dispute arises, the parties shall negotiate amicably; if negotiation fails, the dispute shall be resolved through litigation in the people’s court with jurisdiction in the place where the Platform’s operating entity is located.

contact.heading: 7. Contact
contact.body: If you have any questions, please contact customer service via the WeChat account / email address published on the Platform.

meta.title: Privacy Policy · Ziwei Natal Chart
meta.description: Privacy policy for Ziwei Natal Chart

collect.heading: 1. Information We Collect
collect.intro: To provide Ziwei natal chart calculation and reading services, we may collect the following information:
collect.chart: Information needed for the natal chart: name (optional), date of birth in the Gregorian calendar, hour of birth, gender and longitude of the place of birth
collect.account: Account information (after you register): mobile phone number (for SMS verification and membership services)
collect.interaction: Interaction information: your clicks, browsing and natal chart history on the site
collect.feedback: Feedback information: your “accurate / inaccurate” ratings of readings and your written feedback
collect.payment: Payment information: when you buy a membership or a single service, payment is processed by a third-party payment service (Alipay / WeChat Pay); the Platform does not store full card numbers or passwords

use.heading: 2. How We Use Information
use.chart: Natal chart information is used only for the current reading and for the chart history in your account
use.phone: Your mobile number is used for registration, sign-in and order notifications
use.feedback: Feedback information is used to keep improving the quality of the astrological content (analyzed in aggregate after de-identification)
use.aggregate: Aggregated data may be used for industry research and Platform optimization

sharing.heading: 3. Information Sharing and Third Parties
sharing.intro: We do not share your personal information with third parties except in the following cases:
sharing.payment: Payment providers (Alipay / WeChat Pay): to settle orders
sharing.sms: SMS providers (such as Alibaba Cloud SMS): to send verification codes
sharing.cloud: Cloud providers (such as Vercel / Cloudflare / Alibaba Cloud): to host the service
sharing.ai: AI reading services (such as Anthropic Claude): to process your “free-form follow-up” conversations (anonymized)
sharing.authorities: Lawful requests from judicial authorities or government departments under laws and regulations

security.heading: 4. Information Security
security.body: We use technical and administrative measures common in the industry to protect your information (HTTPS encryption in transit, encrypted database storage, access control, etc.). Please note, however, that transmission over the internet cannot be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

rights.heading: 5. Your Rights
rights.access: Access: you can view all your past natal charts and orders in the account center
rights.deletion: Deletion: contact customer service to delete specific natal charts in your account / close your account
rights.export: Export: you can request an export of all your personal data

cookies.heading: 6. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.body: This site uses cookies / localStorage to save your dark/light theme preference, your recent natal chart history and your membership sign-in status. You can turn them off in your browser settings, but some features may be affected.

minors.heading: 7. Minors
minors.body: The Platform’s astrological content is intended for adult users aged 18 and over. Minors should use it with their guardian’s consent and must not use readings for major life decisions.

changes.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: This policy may be updated from time to time. We will give prominent notice of major changes. Continuing to use the Platform means you agree to the updated version.
